purpose: Curated OpenRouter video selector for fictional short drama; no paid generation comparison performed.

implementation.selection_scope: per segment; saved in generation plan and immutable job request
implementation.notes: Seedance 2.5 retains the existing conservative 12-image planner cap. Model changes preserve prompts and character references; incompatible settings block submission rather than dropping inputs.
implementation.google_resolution: Selecting Veo changes 480p to 720p. 1080p stays selected. The live catalog is checked before submission.

findings.finding: OutputAudioSensitiveContentDetected concerns generated audio. Separate PolicyViolation suffix explicitly mentions copyright. Generic text alone does not establish the triggering words or category.

findings.kind: public issue report, not controlled comparison
findings.finding: Includes a Seedance 2.0 task failing with OutputAudioSensitiveContentDetected. Switching to 2.0 cannot be presented as a reliable moderation fix.
Documents input/output moderation and DataInspectionFailed/IPInfringementSuspect; does not measure Wan 3.0 moderation against Seedance.
Wan 3.0 supports native dialogue/audio, 30 seconds, and up to 10 reference images. OpenRouter route behavior still requires a real generation test.
Documents native multimodal audio-video generation and up to nine image references.
Reports moderation failures for fictional fantasy. Not evidence of a measured rejection rate or a reliable model ranking.
GA Veo 3.1 supports native sound, reference images, portrait framing, and 720p or higher output. Reference-to-video uses eight seconds. No paid OpenRouter test performed.

conclusion: Offer a small model choice for quality/reliability comparison. No verified least-censored ranking; provider/route/input/output can all affect moderation. Preserve story and diagnose specific errors rather than claiming a trigger from generic messages.
